violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

violation_type.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

finding_variants.text: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.
Two infants ages 13m and 17 months old were mixed with a 4 year old child.

During an inspection, it was observed a 5 month old infant was in a classroom with children more than a 18-month age gap. The oldest child was 6 years old. This was corrected when a caregiver brought the infant to another classroom.
A 12 month old infant was observed in a classroom with a 3 year old child which exceeded the 18 month rule.
One 11 month old infant was observed to be in care with a 4 year old.

A caregiver was observed supervising 11 children in a classroom when the specified age group was 23 months old. This was corrected at inspection when 2 children were removed from the room bringing the classroom into ratio.
